title: fix(lint)!: os validate refuses an analyticsCubes member the analytics door refuses — a dimension over a JSON-stored column, and count_distinct over one
body:
Fixes #21082
Clause-②: no (narrowing)

## What changes

`@objectstack/lint`'s dataset-member rule (`packages/lint/src/validate-dataset-measure-aggregates.ts`) gains a cube leg. It walks `analyticsCubes` and refuses the three shapes that the analytics door (`service-analytics` `structured-json-dimension-door.ts`) refuses with `400 INVALID_FIELD`:

1. a cube dimension whose `sql` column is structured-JSON (`STRUCTURED_JSON_TYPES`);
2. a cube dimension whose `sql` column is multi-value (`isMultiValueField`, `multiple: true` included);
3. a cube `count_distinct` measure whose `sql` column is JSON-stored (the table's `count_distinct` row AND `isMultiValueField`).

**No parallel copy.** The verdicts are the dataset leg's own helpers, `groupKeyClassOf` and `acceptsDeclaration`. The findings carry the dataset leg's two ids:

- `dimension-json-stored-field-refused`, at `analyticsCubes[N].dimensions.KEY.sql`;
- `measure-aggregate-field-type-refused`, at `analyticsCubes[N].measures.KEY.type`.

The dataset and cube legs now share two builders for the finding text. The dataset findings stay byte-identical (measured below).

The column is read the way the door reads it (`analytics-service.ts`, `hop-object.ts`):

- **The cube's object** is its `sql`, trimmed, when it names an object the stack defines with a field map.
- **A member's `sql`** is either a column of that object, or a relationship path whose leaf is read on the object its last hop reaches.
  - A hop the cube declares a join for reaches that join's `name`. This is the door's first tier.
  - Every other hop is walked by the shared `resolveFieldPath`. This is the door's second tier.
  - A hop the graph cannot follow is skipped.
- **`'*'`** resolves to nothing and is skipped on both member kinds. Whether `'*'` belongs on a dimension or on a non-count measure is #21000's question, and it is not refused here.

**Not judged here:** cube `sum` / `avg` / `min` / `max`, which are the #21044 door's pairs. See Acceptance notes.

**Runtime door.** The registry entry is unchanged (`runtimeTypes: ['dataset']`). A `dataset` write's per-write snapshot carries no `analyticsCubes`, so the cube leg reads nothing at the runtime door. `authoring-rules.ts` gains a comment that says so.

**Files changed:**

- the rule and its tests;
- that comment in `authoring-rules.ts`;
- a cube paragraph in §6 of `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx`;
- one changeset.

`index.ts` is untouched.

## Clause-②: the measured arm

`node scripts/pm/check-widening-tells.mjs --declaration no --diff` on the final diff exits 0. It also reports all 5 files as NOT MEASURED, because no declared surface covers `packages/lint`, so it decided nothing.

The arm therefore comes from the dispatch's criterion:

- The diff adds 0 `export` lines in `packages/lint/src` (tests excluded). The positive control, the model commit `5e470f8c1c`, adds 1.
- `index.ts`, `runtime.ts` and `package.json` are unchanged.

So the diff adds no symbol and no listing row, and the arm is `no (narrowing)`. The changeset is still BREAKING because metadata that used to pass `os validate` can now fail. It carries `!`, the banner, `minor`, and one ADR-0087 marker: `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.

## `os validate`, before (`4b20c84748`) and after (`07a308acdc`)

Each fixture is `fx_ledger` plus one cube, `fx_cube`.

| fixture | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| `cube-json-dim` (dimension `meta`, `sql: 'meta'`, over `json`), the card's measured instance | exit 0 | **exit 1** (`dimension-json-stored-field-refused`) |
| dimension over `tags` | exit 0 | **exit 1** |
| dimension over `select` with `multiple: true` | exit 0 | **exit 1** |
| dimension over `account.hq` (lookup to `fx_account`, where `hq` is `json`) | exit 0 | **exit 1** |
| `count_distinct` over `json` | exit 0 | **exit 1** (`measure-aggregate-field-type-refused`) |
| `count_distinct` over `select` with `multiple: true` | exit 0 | **exit 1** |
| scalar control (see below) | exit 0 | exit 0 |

The scalar control has dimensions over `text`, a single `select` and `account.name`, and `count_distinct` over `text` and a single `select`.

**Corpus after:** `os validate` passes on `examples/app-showcase`, `app-crm` and `app-todo`, with 0 findings of either id. App-showcase holds `showcase_delivery`, the repo's one real cube.

## Tests

`src/validate-dataset-measure-aggregates.test.ts` gains 11 cube tests:

- each shape, paired with a scalar control;
- a sweep of every `FieldType`, flagged and not, against the door's predicates;
- the reference tier and the declared-join tier;
- the skips and the `'*'` wildcard;
- report order;
- `runAuthoringRules` on all three commands.

Runs at `07a308acdc`:

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: 119 files, 5586 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck`: exit 0. `--listFiles` shows the test file is in the `tsconfig.test.json` program.

**Byte identity of the dataset leg.** I ran BASE's rule and HEAD's rule over 98 stacks: every aggregate × every `FieldType` × the `multiple` flag, plus joined paths and missing names. They produced 920 findings with 0 mismatches. As a control, a perturbed copy of the old rule produced 26 mismatches.

**Ablations.** Each one went through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on the committed tree. Every restore was proven by its blob hash matching HEAD and by an empty `git diff HEAD`.

| ablation | result |
|---|---|
| A1: cube walk dropped | 8 red / 37 green |
| A2: declared-join tier disabled | 1 red (the join test: without the tier, the lookup's target is judged instead of the join's) |
| A3: cube `count_distinct` leg disabled | 5 red |
| A4: cube measure leg widened to every aggregate | 1 red (`judges only count_distinct`) |

## Gates

All gates ran at `07a308acdc`:

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands` derived 90 commands. I ran all 90.
- I also ran the 4 roster gates whose roster sits under a changed path: `check-changeset-fixed`, `check:authz-resolver`, `check:error-code-casing` and `check:filter-alias-parity`.
- All 94 exit 0.
- `check:skill-examples` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: 8 packages had no `dist`). After those packages were built, both exit 0.
- `--ran` reconciliation: 90 derived, 90 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.

`main` has moved 6 commits since the branch point, and the branch is not merged with it. None of those commits touches `packages/lint` or the docs page. CI's merge ref tests the combined state.

## Changeset

`.changeset/21082-cube-member-json-stored-refused.md`: `@objectstack/lint` `minor`, BREAKING. It states what is refused, what an author now sees, and what is unchanged.

## Acceptance notes

- **Cube `sum` / `avg` / `min` / `max` are not judged at authoring.** The cube door from #21044 refuses those pairs at query time. Measured at `07a308acdc`: a cube `sum` over a `text` column passes `os validate` with exit 0. This is the same family as this card. It is reported to the seat, not fixed here.
- **The runtime `analytics_cube` write door runs no authoring rule.** No rule declares that type, and `TYPE_TO_STACK_KEY` has no row for it. This was read from code, not measured. Carrier: none.
